subject: Lifecycle impact ask and comms timing proposal for v2 chat-deprec
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Lifecycle impact ask and comms timing proposal for v2 chat-deprec

Hi team,

Following up from last week's sync with Orchard Health (Tom), we need to confirm a few cross-functional decisions so we can finalize the customer-facing timing and the migration playbook. Key asks below — I've attached a first-pass impact matrix and a comms draft.

Asks: 
- Product: can we confirm the hard deprecation date for the v2 chat endpoint (currently tentatively 2027-01-15) and any mandatory feature parity requirements customers must hit before cutover?
- Platform/Engineering: can we guarantee a rollback path for the first 72 hours after cutover and an emergency fallback route (e.g., pin-to-v1) if latency spikes?
- Sales/CS: are we comfortable with a 60-day notice and the proposed segmented comms (pilot users 45d, enterprise accounts 60d)?

Constraints we heard from Orchard: Tom wants at least 60 days and a clear opt-in pilot. Legal may request contract addenda for expanded uptime credits if cutover impacts SLAs.

Next steps I'd like by EOD Friday: confirmation on the deprecation date (or a narrowed window), a short bullet on the rollback plan, and any major customer-facing messaging edits.

Attachment: 20261103-migration-impact-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: migration_comms_draft.md (markdown)

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Lifecycle impact ask and comms timing proposal for v2 chat-deprec

Monica — thanks for the clear list. Quick replies from Product: 

- Deprecation timing: 2027-01-15 is still our target but we need a final gating item: the streaming API parity for the new chat model. If streaming parity lands by 2026-12-10, we can keep 01/15; otherwise we should shift to 02/01. I'll own a go/no-go decision on 12/11.
- Feature parity: the only mandatory capability the product team needs is streaming + function-calling parity for the most common call patterns (we'll share a short checklist).
- Customer impact: recommend the segmented cadence you proposed. Add an early technical preview invite for top-5 adopters (2 weeks prior to general notice).

I'll add the checklist to the Drive folder and link it into the matrix.

Marissa
Product Lead, API Experience
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 08:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Lifecycle impact ask and comms timing proposal for v2 chat-deprec

Quick notes from Sales: 

- Orchard is a tier-2 account but with expansion in clinical summarization on the roadmap — we should treat them as high-touch for comms. Tom specifically asked for a pilot/opt-in lane.
- 60 days is acceptable if we give a clear migration checklist and a staging key for testing. Please include a sample mutual action plan (MAP) in the comms so customers know required checkpoints.
- If Legal needs contract language, flag me and I'll coordinate with our AE and legal counsel. We should avoid SLA credit changes unless Legal pushes it.

Also: quick ask to Product/Platform — can we produce a short compatibility shim (client-side wrapper) to smooth tokenization differences? That would reduce friction for our customers and speed migrations.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 12:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Lifecycle impact ask and comms timing proposal for v2 chat-deprec

Ops view / feasibility:

- Rollback path: we can implement an automated pin-to-v1 policy for affected customers for the first 72 hours; will require a small feature flag change and a runbook. We estimate ~3 engineer-days to implement and test the policy per region (US/EU).
- Emergency fallback: we can route traffic to a lower-capacity v1 cluster, but there will be increased latency; we must document expected behavior in the comms.
- Telemetry: suggest we add a post-cutover regression check (sampling 1% of requests for quality/regression alerts) tied to the rollout. That should be part of the monitor runbook.

I'll open a small infra ticket and tag Marissa for the checklist integration.

PT: Priyom Das
Platform Engineering, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@orchardhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Legal Team <legal@orchardhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Nov 2026 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Lifecycle impact ask and comms timing proposal for v2 chat-deprec

Tom — looping you in with the internal decisions so far and our proposed plan: 

1) Target deprecation: 2027-01-15 (product will confirm 12/11 after streaming parity validation; if not ready we push to 2027-02-01).
2) Notice window: 60 days for full customers; 45 days for pilot invitees. We'll send a pilot invite ~2026-12-01 for your team to opt in.
3) Rollback & fallback: Platform will add a pin-to-v1 rollback for 72 hours post-cutover and an emergency fallback route (with expected higher latency). We'll document this in the MAP and runbook.
4) Comms: attached is the draft comms and impact matrix. We will add a MAP and a short client-side shim suggestion to make tokenization/compatibility easier.

Next ask from you: confirm if Orchard wants a contract addendum for credits tied to cutover impact (Legal on your side is cc'd) and if the pilot lane timing looks workable. If you prefer a later general cutover, say so and we'll re-evaluate.

Attachment: 20261103-migration-impact-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: migration_comms_draft.md (markdown)

Thanks — I'll schedule a 30-min follow-up next week if helpful.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
